title: A history version saved before the release shows one representative
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: Before the release, an open work order with one sales representative was saved to its history, and you open that version after the release.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Before the release was installed, work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} had {Sales-rep-B} as its one Sales Representative, and a version of it was saved to its history with {Sales-rep-B}; it is still open and not invoiced.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-39002.
  • Starting screen: the release is installed and {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1}'s history.
  2. Open the version saved before the release.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the history opens.
  • Step 2: that version shows one "Sales Representative" field reading {Sales-rep-B} as plain text; it is not split.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-R17: “Once the work order is invoiced or paid, or when it is opened from its history, each field is plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. A work order with both fields shows both labels with their names. On the read-only card only the Sales Representative fields read as in S1-R2 and S2-R5; Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's read-only labels.”

From: Tech plan "Splitting Sales Representatives — Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 14 Oct 2026, planned against PRD version 8; uploaded 19 Oct 2026 and again, byte-identical, 22 Oct 2026), read in full 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan, frontend risks: “Old WO history snapshots lack `sales_rep_split`; treated as not split. Old history entries lack C4 fields; rendered as today.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
